description:
Create an exploratory visualization using the loaded 'ExamAnxiety.csv' dataset. 

1. Go to 'Descriptives' > 'Descriptive Statistics'.
2. Open the 'Plots' section (specifically 'Basic plots' or 'Scatterplots' depending on the version).
3. Create a Scatterplot with 'Anxiety' on the X-axis and 'Exam' on the Y-axis.
4. Add a regression line and set the line type to 'Smooth' (Loess/Non-linear).
5. Add 'Marginal plots' to the scatterplot and set them to 'Histogram'.
6. Save the analysis as '/home/ga/Documents/JASP/ExploratoryPlot.jasp'.
